title: VideoGameQA-Bench: A Benchmark for Vision-Language Models on Video Game Quality Assurance
key_findings: VLMs struggle significantly with subtle visual regressions and precise spatio-temporal glitch localization in long gameplay videos.
primary_limitations: High inference latency; poor fine-grained bounding localization for micro-clipping.

title: Hybrid Co-FineTuning for Visual Bug Detection in Video Games
key_findings: Co-finetuning on unlabelled gameplay frames substantially improves glitch recall without requiring expensive exhaustive per-frame labels.
primary_limitations: Suffers severe performance degradation when moving across radically different art styles (e.g. realistic to voxel).

title: State-Aware Visual Glitch Detection in Complex 3D Video Games
key_findings: Combining game-engine internal state (transform matrices and collision queries) with RGB vision reduces false positives by 42% compared to RGB-only.
primary_limitations: Requires engine-level instrumentation hooks; cannot be used as a black-box tester on closed commercial builds.

title: How Far Can VLMs Go for Automated Visual Bug Detection in Video Games?
key_findings: General-purpose VLMs exhibit strong zero-shot qualitative bug identification but suffer hallucinated bug reports on stylized or non-photorealistic art.
primary_limitations: Low temporal sensitivity; prone to confusing stylistic art direction with actual rendering bugs.

title: TempGlitch: Detecting Temporal Visual Glitches in Continuous Gameplay Video Streams
key_findings: Single-frame anomaly detectors miss over 65% of animation and flickering glitches; temporal attention is critical for real-world gameplay streams.
primary_limitations: Extremely high computational footprint; unsuitable for 60 FPS real-time automated playtest pipelines.

title: Automatically Detecting Visual Bugs in HTML5 Canvas Games
key_findings: Automated CV pipeline effectively identifies missing assets and rendering differences in 2D web canvas game loops.
primary_limitations: Limited to 2D isometric/flat planes; fails in dynamic 3D lighting or procedural environments.

title: Video Game Automated Testing Approaches: An Assessment Framework
key_findings: Comprehensive classification of game testing techniques
primary_limitations: highlighting visual regression as the least automated and most error-prone sector.
column17: Does not propose a deep learning visual anomaly detection pipeline.

title: A Literature Review of Software Testing Practices and Frameworks in the Video Gaming Industry
key_findings: Identifies that while functional testing is transitioning to AI
primary_limitations: visual QA remains 80% manual in AAA game studios due to lack of generalizable CV tools.
column17: Provides broad SE perspective but lacks technical benchmarking of CV/VLM architectures.
